description: This file defines an internal interface ICatalog within the Orleans.Runtime namespace, representing a remote interface for managing grain and activation states, including deletion of activations on a silo.

classes.name: ICatalog
classes.description: An internal interface for managing grain activations and states across a silo, including deletion operations.

methods.name: DeleteActivations
methods.description: Asynchronous method to delete specified grain activations from the silo, providing addresses, reason code, and reason text for the operation.
